description:
Samsung Wallpapers
Wallpaper manager. Needed to pick up a wallpaper on Android 10+.
Has INTERNET permission and ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION
Before Android 10, you should still be able to set a wallpaper from the Samsung gallery without this package.
WARNING: Removing this app will prevent you to set a new wallpaper on Android 10+ (even from the Gallery) or changing the Material You palette on Android 12+.
